theme_central: Quraysh's trading pact (winter and summer journeys) as a blessing that makes the exclusive worship of the Lord of the House all the more legitimate.
sources_note: Universally known content, no possible divergence.

branches.title: The pact of Quraysh
branches.resume: The pact of Quraysh for the winter and summer trading journeys, secured by Mecca's divine protection.

children.t: Quraysh's secured trading pact, blessing recalled

branches.title: Call to worship
branches.resume: Let them worship the Lord of this House, who fed them and secured them from fear.

children.t: Call to worship the Lord of the House, provider and protector
